verdict.rationale: Drata documents a versioned Public API: APIv2 is presented as a new generation with expanded endpoints, and the reference lives under /openapi/reference/v2/ paths. Some endpoints are marked experimental (🧪), which gives a hint of lifecycle labeling. However, nothing in the pack documents a deprecation policy, sunset timelines, or a v1 migration or retirement schedule. Missing for 10: documented deprecation policy, sunset/notice timelines, v1-to-v2 migration guidance, changelog or versioning policy, independent corroboration.
